Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

VAPO: Efficient and Reliable Reinforcement Learning for Advanced Reasoning Tasks (2504.05118v3) · paper method: VAPO adjusts policy GAE lambda as a function of output length and a bias-variance control parameter.

cohort8.claim.vapo.length-adaptive

  • Original author-stage note: Author-only candidate: separate source-verifier and adversarial source-content reviews remain pending.
  • Version-specific primary-source report. Proofs, model experiments, underlying data, consent/pay records and supplier participation have not been independently reproduced or audited.
  • The method is lambda=1−1/(alpha×length); experimental alpha and other settings belong to the selected recipe, not an arbitrary task recommendation.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

VAPO: Efficient and Reliable Reinforcement Learning for Advanced Reasoning Tasks (2504.05118v3) · paper method: VAPO pretrains the value model on Monte Carlo returns from a fixed policy before saving and loading that value checkpoint for policy training.

  • Version-specific primary-source report. Proofs, model experiments, underlying data, consent/pay records and supplier participation have not been independently reproduced or audited.
  • This addresses initialization mismatch; it introduces preparation work beyond actor-only optimization.
